content.title: Grundfos 401-3974 Self-Priming Gear Pump, 0.75 in Inlet/Outlet, Mechanical Seal
content.short_description: Grundfos 401-3974 is a self-priming gear pump with 0.75 in inlet and outlet ports and a mechanical seal for fluid containment.
content.long_description:
The Grundfos 401-3974 is a gear-type pump designed for self-priming operation, allowing it to draw fluid into the pump body without requiring the line to be pre-filled. This construction makes it suitable for applications where the pump may be mounted above the fluid source or where intermittent priming loss could occur.

The pump uses a mechanical seal at the shaft to contain process fluid and limit leakage along the drive shaft, an alternative to packing-style seals. Both the inlet and outlet ports are sized at 0.75 in, matching common piping and fitting sizes for fluid transfer setups in this capacity range.

As a gear pump, the 401-3974 moves fluid via the meshing of internal gears, a positive displacement method suited to consistent flow delivery. Procurement and maintenance staff should confirm port sizing, seal compatibility with the process fluid, and self-priming requirements against system specifications before installation.
